identity.title: List of Pokémon Journeys: The Series episodes

leadText: This is a list of episodes of Pokémon Journeys: The Series, which first aired between November 17, 2019 and March 24, 2023 in Japan and between June 12, 2020 and September 8, 2023 in the United States. These episodes follow Ash Ketchum and Goh traveling across all regions of the Pokémon world, as well as Ash's continued travels across the world after he and Goh part ways, where he is joined once more by his first companions, and .
